commits.message: fix(config): every rendered tree places a layer's insert cells, so presets decide their own anchors and clashes (candybar-plugins-vf6g.99v)
feat(config): a repo config can add a cell beside a placement the user already has (candybar-plugins-vf6g.99v)

fix(daemon): a catch-up re-reads watch_file sources, and the row stands while the span is open (brandon-unfiled-3248.y66h)

A `watch_file` source watches through its directory on the same OS stream
the probe tests, so a stall silenced it too, and nothing re-read it when
events resumed. Every registry now subscribes to the delivery owner's
catch-ups, and a catch-up fires each watched file's subscribers as its own
watch would have.

The bar's row and daemon-stats' line derive from the unvouched span, not
the state's label: a probe that landed after a stall is not one heard, so
delivering with the span open still warns, and the stats line names the
span's start in every state.

The causes that reload every entry are their own type, so a single entry's
cause cannot be batched.

fix(daemon): one owner says whether the OS is delivering file events, and an edit made while it wasn't reloads when they resume (brandon-unfiled-3248.y66h)

The daemon writes a probe into a folder of its own each period and judges
delivery for every watch it holds: delivering, stalled, or unmeasured with a
reason. A stall or an unmeasured span draws an amber row naming the span's
start, daemon-stats prints a fileEvents line, and the span's close reloads
every config entry under events-resumed and re-reads every held plugin file.
Plugin storage reads that one owner in place of a probe per folder, and keeps
judging each folder's identity on the owner's period.

feat(diagnostics): every error and warning shows as one indicator with a viewer (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i) (#483)

* feat(diagnostics): every error and warning shows as one indicator with a viewer (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

The red and amber strip above the bar is gone. The settings door's own cell
carries an indicator (⚠ N, red if any error, amber otherwise, 9+ cap) that
reads a per-draw diagnostics projection; clicking it opens a viewer that takes
the body's place and shows one message in full with ✕, ‹ ›, [k/N] and ⧉ copy.
Render warnings are recorded per session and renderer, rewritten only when a
frame is drawn from a new source. A placement of an undeclared segment drops
only its own cell and is reported as an error; check and the demo still refuse
it. The handed-off statusline is the handoff line alone, so an error shows
once. The diagnostic dump, its file:// links and the show-config verbs are
deleted.

* fix(diagnostics): every frame records its render warnings by value, and a moved record wakes the feed (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* fix(diagnostics): the viewer holds its message's key, not a position (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* feat(diagnostics): the statusline's handoff line carries the indicator and opens the viewer (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* fix(config): a failed chain's lower layers are judged by the tolerant validation, and the dead trace seam goes (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* docs(diagnostics): describe the indicator and viewer where the strip was (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* fix(diagnostics): a warning record holds for the config and width it was drawn from, and nothing wakes a feed for it (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* fix(diagnostics): the viewer pages within the terminal's rows, and its key is a message's first line and occurrence (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* test(diagnostics): the viewer fact names its page, and a lane counts a warning on its next spaced frame (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* fix(config): every dropped placement is reported, a replacement plugin is judged tolerantly, and a click never adds a drop (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* fix(config): a click loads the file before it once, and a file that would not load does not blame the click for its drops (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* fix(config): every refusal of a renderable config carries its drops, through one throw (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* fix(diagnostics): a session's warnings are every renderer's on every surface, and a record names its config by generation (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* fix(diagnostics): the viewer's header is measured as drawn, and a message has no page its key cannot name (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* docs(diagnostics): the memory describes the warning records, the viewer's identity keys and why the handler dependency is accepted (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* test(diagnostics): a lane counts the session's warnings from any renderer, still with no wake (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

* fix(diagnostics): a warning still met never looks gone, a message keeps its identity as its text changes, and each drop is blamed on the file that wrote it (candybar-plugins-vf6g.84i)

- A renderer's own warning record stands until its next frame replaces it,
  so a reload or resize never closes and reopens an open viewer.
- A message's identity is what its producer says it is about (a load's
  config, a drop's file, a repository, an update), not its headline.
- The viewer pages within the shortest surface showing it: a feed's frame
  the tmux status line shows gets five rows.
- An undeclared placement owns no id, so two of one typo are two drops.
- A drop a lower layer wrote is reported against that file, at its line.
- A click loads the file before it only when a refusal reads it.
- validateConfig leaves production: check and the demo refuse drops through
  refuseDrops, and the strict form is a test helper.
